decisionProcess.demandMechanism: Recurring corporate-style accommodation and small-to-mid-size meeting needs generated by visiting faculty, speakers, mobility participants, institutional partners, programme launches and project teams; this is an evidence-supported commercial hypothesis, not a documented room block.
decisionProcess.summary: Accessibility is moderate for initial outreach because the campus publishes a named purchasing head, a finance-and-administration executive, a main route and a directory. Actual hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed; no preferred supplier, TMC, travel manager or hotel procurement policy was found.
decisionProcess.notes: Start with Purchasing and Finance/Administration to determine whether accommodation, meetings and catering are sourced separately and whether campus or central Red de Universidades Anáhuac approval is required. Use Institutional Development as an event and partnership referral route.
unknowns: The supplied hotel context is incomplete: official hotel address, website, brand and property-level location advantages were not available.
No named person was publicly verified as a hotel-contract signatory or travel manager.
No preferred hotel, TMC, central travel policy, procurement threshold, booking channel or transient-versus-meetings split was found.
The purchasing head is a credible procurement route, but hotel-contracting authority specifically was not explicitly stated.
The finance/administration vice president is highly relevant to administration and facilities, but hotel sourcing authority was not explicitly stated.
